as_told.title: Pyramids aligned with Orion's Belt as a place where souls ascend

plain: The idea is that the three great pyramids at Giza match the three stars of Orion's Belt, and that the match was exact around 10,600 BC. Michels says this himself: the layout "mapped fully" to the Belt, "around 10,600 BC is when it shifted." The writer Graham Hancock gives a different reason the match matters. He tells Michels that Orion's Belt "has always, across many cultures, been the place of ascension of souls," and he gives no date. If true, the pyramids' layout would record a date far older than standard history allows.
